top_signals.title: Gilts Lead European Bonds Higher as Energy Prices Retreat
top_signals.summary: Gilts extended gains across the curve, with benchmark UK 10-year yields almost 7bps lower as oil and natural gas prices fell to new lows on the day. The moves followed reports that EU officials do not expect the US to ban diesel exports and that Qatar is holding meetings with the US and Iran over the conflict in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cautious on US Bond Market: Purdie
top_signals.summary: Colin Purdie, Manulife CIO of Public Markets, joins Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss opportunities in the global bond market amid rising yields. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Price hikes to hit Japanese households starting next month
top_signals.summary: Households will likely feel an increased financial burden, given that price hikes will also hit a wide range of food products.
